dpc.name: Direct Plated Copper (DPC)
dpc.positioning: Fine-feature and high-frequency ceramic substrates for semiconductor packaging, RF/microwave, photonics, and precision electronics.
dpc.leadTime: Approximately 2 weeks (depending on design complexity, quantity, material and qualification requirements)
dpc.rfOptimization: RF Layout & Engineering Optimization Support up to 40 GHz (actual in-circuit RF performance depends on substrate material, dielectric loss tangent, circuit geometry, metallization, and package architecture)
primaryApplications: RF & Microwave Circuits (with high-frequency layout support up to 40 GHz)

oneOzCopperCapability.lineWidthAccuracy: 0.02 mm (20 µm) with ±0.01 mm (±10 µm) tolerance
oneOzCopperCapability.layerAlignmentPrecision: 15 µm cumulative error across 2/3/4 inch substrates

dualCopperThicknessCapability.description: Capability to fabricate two different copper thicknesses on the same ceramic substrate (e.g. fine-pitch signal lines alongside thick power traces)

throughWaferVias.platingMethod: Simultaneous plating with circuit and top side copper
throughWaferVias.thicknessMeasurement: Destructive micro-sectioning (metallographic cross-section) or 4-wire electrical current testing

currentCapacityRules.dualViaOption: Dual 1 oz (35 µm) Cu through-wafer vias connected in parallel provide ~2.4A current carrying capacity (recommended for up to 2A design)
currentCapacityRules.singleViaOption: Single through-wafer via carrying 2A+ requires 105 µm (3 oz) copper thickness

solidFilledViaGuidelines.recommendedSubstrateThickness: Below 0.40 mm (0.20 mm, 0.25 mm recommended, 0.38 mm supported). Substrate > 0.40 mm risks voids and blistering/bulging above 350°C
solidFilledViaGuidelines.minViaSpacing: > 120 µm (for 0.20 mm vias: pitch > 400 µm, via-to-edge > 40 µm)
solidFilledViaGuidelines.maxViasPerPad: Maximum 2 vias on a single copper pad with minimum 0.15 mm (150 µm) distance between via hole edges

enig.sequence: Electroless/electrolytic Ni plating followed by Au plating after complete Cu plating
enig.processControl: Nickel and Gold bath chemistry governed by Statistical Process Control (SPC)
enig.thicknessInspection: X-ray fluorescence (XRF) 5-point inspection method per panel

surfaceFinishes.qualityDocumentation: Comprehensive Shipment Inspection Test Report (COA) provided with shipments

dbc.name: Direct Bonded Copper (DBC)
dbc.positioning: DBC = High-Current / Power Electronics Ceramic Substrate. Heavy copper foil (0.20 mm – 0.30 mm) eutectic-bonded to Al₂O₃ ceramic for high ampacity (>50A–150A+) and high-voltage dielectric isolation.
dbc.leadTime: Approximately 2 weeks (depending on design complexity, quantity, material and qualification requirements)
dbc.copperThickness: 0.20 mm, 0.25 mm, 0.30 mm (direct bonded oxygen-containing copper foil)
primaryApplications: Renewable Energy Inverters (Solar PV & Wind Converters)
Welding Equipment & Induction Heating Power Stages

htcc.name: High-Temperature Co-Fired Ceramic (HTCC)
htcc.positioning: HTCC = Multilayer + Hermetic + Harsh Environment. Monolithic multilayer ceramic packaging co-fired at 1500°C–1600°C with tungsten/molybdenum conductors, internal cavities, and hermetic seal rings (<1×10⁻⁸ atm·cc/s).
htcc.leadTime: Approximately 6–8 weeks (depending on design complexity, layer count, tooling, and qualification requirements)
htcc.metallization: Refractory conductors (Tungsten W / Molybdenum Mo) with post-sinter nickel/gold electroplating
features: Internal signal and ground plane routing
Integrated cavities for die placement and optical components
Brazed seal rings, feedthroughs, and metal leads (Kovar, Cu-W)
High thermal and chemical stability in extreme environments

bareCeramics.name: Bare Ceramic Substrates
bareCeramics.positioning: Partner-sourced technical ceramic raw plates with in-house precision laser cutting, CNC diamond grinding, polishing, and ultrasonic cleaning.
bareCeramics.capacity: Capacity: up to 500,000 bare ceramic substrates per month
materials: Silicon Nitride (Si₃N₄, high fracture toughness and flexural strength)
Silicon Carbide (SiC, extreme hardness and thermal conductivity)
Zirconia (ZrO₂ / Y-TZP, high mechanical strength and wear resistance)
